paragraphs: R' Azariah, son of R' Simon.
Mentioned in Ruth Rabbah 2:7, but Hyman calls this a scribal error: it should read “in the name of R' Simon,” as the statement appears in Bereshit Rabbah 68:6.[^1]

notes.text: רו״ר/ב״ר are contextually Ruth Rabbah/Bereshit Rabbah; פ״ב-ז and פס״ח-ו are read 2:7/68:6, without independently verified modern correspondence. ט״ס/צ״ל preserve Hyman’s definite scribal-error/should-read assertion, which changes a father relation into a reporting relation rather than supplying a verified genealogy. Both father-title and reporting-title components remain R', as does Azariah’s title.
